1.why: Reset verification requires record.sessionId === session.id, binding the token to the requesting session, though there is no multi-user identity store.

2.why: The same reset token fails for another session because verification rejects records when record.sessionId !== session.id.

3.why: Password change only clears mfaVerified on the current session and never invalidates or deletes other entries in the sessions Map.

4.why: Bun.serve is configured with TLS cert/key and HTTP 308-redirects to HTTPS with HSTS, but the TLS protocol version is not explicitly pinned in code.

5.why: Reset tokens are stored as SHA-256 verifiers and passwords with argon2id, but MFA codes and session fields sit in memory in plaintext and are not encrypted.

6.why: No email is composed or sent at all; recovery only returns a generic JSON message and an academic testingToken.

7.why: Inputs are strictly validated (validContact, validToken, passwordIssue, JSON body checks) and the client writes only via textContent.

8.why: Navigation uses fixed in-app paths via pushState and the only redirect is the HTTP→HTTPS localhost upgrade with no user-controlled URL.

9.why: There are no email templates and no user input is embedded into any HTML email, so no script/HTML injection path exists there.

10.why: Server errors are generic, but API responses and the client Logs panel deliberately expose testingToken and testingMfaCode values.

11.why: Password hashes use argon2id/env, yet recovery and login MFA codes are hardcoded literals (482913, 741852) in the source.

12.why: No default password is present; login requires a non-empty passwordHash from env or a prior argon2id hash and fails otherwise.

13.why: recordAttempt/blocked enforce per-action limits (e.g. 3–5 failures) with a 60s lockout on recovery, verify, MFA, and login.

14.why: /api/recovery always returns the same generic eligibility message whether or not the contact is valid.

15.why: The reset token is randomHex(32) and session-bound, but the paired recovery MFA code is the fixed string 482913 rather than random.
